targetTexts.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
targetTexts.2: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
targetTexts.3: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
targetTexts.4: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
targetTexts.5: In my distress I called to the LORD, and He answered and set me free.
targetTexts.6: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
targetTexts.7: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
targetTexts.8: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in man.
targetTexts.9: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
targetTexts.10: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
targetTexts.11: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
targetTexts.12: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
targetTexts.13: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
targetTexts.14: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
targetTexts.15: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
targetTexts.16: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
targetTexts.17: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
targetTexts.18: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
targetTexts.19: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
targetTexts.20: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous shall enter through it.
targetTexts.21: I will give You thanks, for You have answered me, and You have become my salvation.
targetTexts.22: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.
targetTexts.23: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
targetTexts.24: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
targetTexts.25: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
targetTexts.26: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
targetTexts.27: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
targetTexts.28: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
targetTexts.29: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
